$comment: The app's key screens, captured from each platform's preview build (#331). Each screen opens by deep link (sdachurchapp://<path>) after its settings are saved; each variant adds the settings listed under variants. Screenshots are named <platform>/<screen>-<variant>.png. checks lists automatic image checks for a screen, mustShowLines regular expressions that some line of its text must match, mustNotShowLines ones that no line may match, variantRules more of either for one variant, and tabs false for a screen without the tab bar, such as the Bible while reading (scripts/check-screens.cjs); appStore lists, per App Store language, the shots to upload, in order. Leave out screens that show members' names or photos, such as the bulletin, the team page, the fellowship page, and the worship schedule. See docs/operations/native-builds.md.

screens.name: home
screens.$comment: xl-ios-large-text and es-xl-ios-large-text: the app at 200% with the iPhone's accessibility-large text (2×), about 4× in all, as with Android's largest font at 200%, where the tab labels used to wrap (#380). The tab-label check fails on a wrapped label, or one pushed up out of the tab bar's area by an overgrown bar. Not the iPhone's very largest size: at about 6× in all, page titles break mid-word, which isn't a useful baseline.

screens.name: bible-dual
screens.$comment: The header's translation button in full: the 文A icon (read as XA), the EN badge, and both names, not cut to B… or C… (#376).

screens.name: bible-dual-back
screens.$comment: Opened from Home, so the header also has a back arrow and less room. When it's tight, the translation button gives up its 文A icon first, then the length of its names, then its badges (#376). At 150% and 200% only the icon goes: the EN badge and both full names stay.

screens.name: bible-cuv
screens.$comment: Mandarin is the default narrator, so the audio button shows 國語.

screens.name: bible-cuv-cantonese
screens.$comment: With the Cantonese narrator chosen, the audio button shows 粵語.

screens.name: bible-cuv-after-spanish
screens.$comment: The Spanish Bible was open with the CUV underneath, then a link opens the CUV. Its book names must replace the Spanish ones, which once stayed until a restart (#373). The interface is English, as when the bug showed, so Vision reads the dock in English first and misses 詩篇; it reads a stale Salmos reliably.

screens.name: bible-cuvs
screens.$comment: Simplified characters, so the audio button shows 国语.

screens.name: bible-scrolled
screens.$comment: Opens at John 3:14, so earlier verses sit under the status bar; checks it stays clear.

screens.name: bible-long-chapter
screens.$comment: Psalm 119 from verse 100, for three-digit verse numbers at large text sizes.

screens.name: explore
screens.$comment: xl-ios-large-text and es-xl-ios-large-text check the tab labels at about 4× text, as on Home (#380).
